cards.front: No puedo evitar darle vueltas a qué hacer después.
cards.back: I can't help wondering what to do next.

cards.front: Ella no puede evitar comprar sandalias cuando pasa por delante de esta tienda.
cards.back: She can't help buying sandals when she walks past this shoe shop.

cards.front: Él no puede evitar decir palabrotas cuando ve un partido de fútbol.
cards.back: He can't help swearing when he watches a football game.

cards.front: Estoy impaciente por quedar con Kylie y Jamie.
cards.back: I can't wait to meet up with Kylie and Jamie.

cards.front: Estoy deseando quedar contigo otra vez.
cards.back: I can't wait to meet you again.

cards.front: No veo la hora de pasar un buen rato con él.
cards.back: I can't wait to spend some quality time with him.

cards.front: Él no soporta que le interrumpan cuando está hablando.
cards.back: He can't stand being interrupted when he's speaking.

cards.front: No soporto la gente que habla por el móvil en el autobús.
cards.back: I can't stand people talking on their phones on the bus.

cards.front: No soporto cuando la gente dice una cosa y hace lo contrario.
cards.back: I can't stand it when people say one thing and do the opposite.

cards.front: Ella no soporta que su madre le critique.
cards.back: She can't bear being criticized by her mother.

cards.front: Él no soporta algunos programas de la tele.
cards.back: He can't bear some TV programmes.

cards.front: No aguantan a sus vecinos.
cards.back: They can't bear their neighbours.

cards.front: Ella no soporta a alguien que esté todo el día metiéndose el dedo en la nariz.
cards.back: She can't put up with someone picking their nose all day.

cards.front: Él no soporta a una chica que esté todo el día diciendo palabrotas.
cards.back: He can't put up with a girl swearing all day.

cards.front: ¿Puedes aguantar a alguien que te esté diciendo el día entero lo que tienes que hacer?
cards.back: Can you put up with someone telling you what to do all day?

cards.front: ¿Sabrías decir cuántos años tiene?
cards.back: Can you tell how old he is?

cards.front: ¿No sabrías decir cuánto pesa?
cards.back: Can't you tell how much it weighs?

cards.front: No sabría decir qué altura tiene esta habitación.
cards.back: I can't tell the height of this room.

cards.front: ¿Distingues una picadura de mosquito de una de pulga?
cards.back: Can you tell the difference between a mosquito bite and a flea bite?

cards.front: Ella no distingue una sonrisa falsa de una real.
cards.back: She can't tell the difference between a fake smile and a real one.

cards.front: Él no distingue las extensiones del pelo auténtico.
cards.back: He can't tell the difference between hair extensions and real hair.

cards.front: No distingo a un gemelo del otro.
cards.back: I can't tell the two identical twins apart.

cards.front: Ella distingue entre un músico y el otro, pero yo no.
cards.back: She can tell the two musicians apart, but I can't.

cards.front: ¿Distingues uno del otro?
cards.back: Can you tell them apart?

cards.front: ¿Distingues cuando alguien te está mintiendo?
cards.back: Can you tell when someone is lying to you?

cards.front: ¿Distingues cuando alguien se está empezando a enfadar?
cards.back: Can you tell when someone's starting to get angry?

cards.front: ¿Distingues cuando alguien a quien estás hablando se aburre?
cards.back: Can you tell when someone you're talking to is bored?

cards.front: Sé por la letra que mi padre escribió esta nota.
cards.back: I can tell by the handwriting that my father wrote this note.

cards.front: Sé por su acento que son extranjeros.
cards.back: I can tell by their accent that they are foreigners.

cards.front: Está claro por las arrugas de la cara que ella ha abusado del sol.
cards.back: You can tell by her wrinkled face she's sunbathed too much.

cards.front: Por favor, ¿me podría decir dónde está la papelería más cercana?
cards.back: Could you please tell me where the nearest stationer's is?

cards.front: Por favor, ¿podría mandar este documento por fax a la oficina central?
cards.back: Could you please fax this document to Head Office?

cards.front: Por favor, ¿podría decirle al señor Pilgrim que estoy aquí?
cards.back: Could you please let Mr Pilgrim know I'm here?

cards.front: Richard sabía hablar italiano cuando tenía 5 años.
cards.back: Richard could speak Italian when he was five.

cards.front: Richard y Alberto sabían hacer malabares cuando eran adolescentes.
cards.back: Richard and Alberto could juggle when they were teenagers.

cards.front: Alison no podía hacer el pino cuando tenía 8 años.
cards.back: Alison couldn't do a headstand when she was eight.

cards.front: Después de un día ajetreado, pude llegar puntual a la fiesta.
cards.back: After a hectic day, I was able to arrive at the party on time.

cards.front: Tim pudo terminar de escribir el informe a tiempo para la reunión.
cards.back: Tim was able to finish writing the report in time for the meeting.

cards.front: Pudieron presentar la solicitud dentro del plazo.
cards.back: They were able to submit their application on time.

cards.front: Él no pudo cruzar la meta.
cards.back: He couldn't cross the finish line.

cards.front: Ella no supo plantear ninguna idea buena en la sesión de brainstorming.
cards.back: She couldn't come up with any good ideas for the brainstorming session.

cards.front: La policía no pudo coger al ladrón que robó en casa de mi vecino.
cards.back: The police couldn't catch the burglar who broke into my neighbour's house.

cards.front: Tuve un poco de tiempo libre la semana pasada y pude ir al cine con ella.
cards.back: I had some free time last week and was able to go to the cinema with her.

cards.front: Él no tuvo nada de tiempo libre esta mañana y no pudo ayudar a Luis.
cards.back: He didn't have any free time this morning and wasn't able to help Luis.

cards.front: Tuvieron un poco de tiempo libre la semana pasada y pudieron pintar su casa.
cards.back: They had some free time last week and were able to paint their house.

cards.front: Ella podrá conseguir entradas si llega pronto a la taquilla.
cards.back: She will be able to get tickets if she gets to the box office early.

cards.front: Podré ir a casa de Susan si la reunión termina pronto.
cards.back: I'll be able to go to Susan's if the meeting finishes early.

cards.front: Tom podrá pasarse por casa si se va de la oficina pronto.
cards.back: Tom will be able to come over if he leaves the office early.

cards.front: Podremos jugar al tenis el sábado a no ser que esté granizando.
cards.back: We'll be able to play tennis on Saturday unless it's hailing.

cards.front: Podrán ir de acampada la semana que viene a no ser que esté diluviando.
cards.back: They'll be able to go camping next week unless it's raining cats and dogs.

cards.front: Él podrá conducir su coche a no ser que haya niebla.
cards.back: He'll be able to drive his car unless it's foggy.

cards.front: Podrás cambiar una rueda pinchada siempre y cuando tengas un gato.
cards.back: You'll be able to change a flat tire as long as you have a jack.

cards.front: Podrás preparar una barra de pan siempre y cuando tengas huevos, harina, leche y levadura.
cards.back: You'll be able to bake a loaf of bread as long as you have eggs, flour, milk and yeast.

cards.front: Podrás limpiar el suelo siempre y cuando tengas lejía y una fregona.
cards.back: You'll be able to clean the floor as long as you have bleach and a mop.

cards.front: Podrás venir siempre y cuando lleves puesto un disfraz.
cards.back: You'll be able to come provided you wear a fancy dress costume.

cards.front: Él podrá entrar siempre y cuando tenga más de 18 años.
cards.back: He'll be able to get in provided he's over 18.

cards.front: Ella podrá aparcar su coche en el parking siempre y cuando nos lo haga saber antes.
cards.back: She'll be able to park her car in the car park provided she lets us know in advance.

cards.front: Podré estar ahí antes de las tres siempre y cuando el avión salga puntual.
cards.back: I'll be able to get there before three providing the plane leaves on time.

cards.front: Podremos llegar puntuales a la boda siempre y cuando salgamos de casa antes de las diez.
cards.back: We'll be able to get to the wedding on time providing we leave home before ten.

cards.front: Podrán llegar a casa a las cinco siempre y cuando el partido termine a su hora.
cards.back: They'll be able to get home at five providing the game finishes on time.

cards.front: Nunca me haré rico si continúo trabajando para otra persona.
cards.back: I won't be able to make a killing if I continue working for somebody else.

cards.front: Él no podrá llegar a fin de mes si continúa apostando en las carreras de caballos.
cards.back: He won't be able to make ends meet if he keeps betting on horses.

cards.front: Ella no podrá venir a la fiesta de despedida de Tim si no hace las paces con Susan.
cards.back: She won't be able to come to Tim's leaving party if she doesn't make up with Susan.

cards.front: No podré inflar todos los globos ni aunque me pase el día entero haciéndolo.
cards.back: I won't be able to blow up all the balloons even if I spend the whole day doing it.

cards.front: No podemos aprobar el examen aunque estudiemos toda la noche.
cards.back: We won't be able to pass the exam even if we study all night long.

cards.front: No podrán terminarlo a tiempo ni contratando a un par de personas más para hacerlo.
cards.back: They won't be able to finish it in time even if they take on a couple of people to do it.

cards.front: No podré hacer ejercicio a no ser que Peter me devuelva mi bici.
cards.back: I won't be able to do any exercise unless Peter gives me my bike back.

cards.front: No podremos hacer nada al respecto a no ser que sea de vital importancia.
cards.back: We won't be able to do anything about it unless it's of vital importance.

cards.front: El fontanero no podrá hacer nada acerca de la gotera a no ser que la compañía de seguros se lo diga.
cards.back: The plumber won't be able to do anything about the leak unless the insurance company tells him to.

cards.front: No podrán hacer nada porque no han llegado a un acuerdo.
cards.back: They won't be able to do anything because they haven't come to an agreement.

cards.front: No podré usar la lavadora porque vino sin instrucciones.
cards.back: I won't be able to use the washing machine because it didn't come with instructions.

cards.front: Ella no podrá volver a ponérselo porque la mancha no ha salido.
cards.back: She won't be able to wear it again because the stain hasn't come out.

cards.front: Como me olvidé la gaita en casa, no podré tocarla.
cards.back: As I left the bagpipes at home, I won't be able to play them.

cards.front: Como ella se olvidó el disfraz en casa, no podrá ponérselo.
cards.back: As she left her fancy dress costume at home, she won't be able to wear it.

cards.front: Como él se olvidó la declaración de la renta en la oficina, no podrá hablar de ello con su abogado.
cards.back: As he left his tax-return in the office, he won't be able to talk to his lawyer about it.

cards.front: ¿Podrás entender esto si no estudias?
cards.back: Will you be able to understand this if you don't study?

cards.front: ¿Podrá él ganarle a ella si no juega bien?
cards.back: Will he be able to beat her if he doesn't play well?

cards.front: ¿Podrá ella completar toda su carga de trabajo si no trabaja duro?
cards.back: Will she be able to complete her workload if she doesn't work hard?

cards.front: Si nadie te ayuda a recoger todo este lío, ¿podrás recogerlo tú solo?
cards.back: If nobody helps you to tidy this mess, will you be able to tidy it by yourself?

cards.front: Si nadie le ayuda a empezar con su negocio, ¿podrá empezarlo él solo?
cards.back: If nobody helps him to start his business, will he be able to start it by himself?

cards.front: Si nadie le ayuda a dejar de fumar, ¿podrá hacerlo ella sola?
cards.back: If nobody helps her to quit smoking, will she be able to do it by herself?

cards.front: ¿Podrá la gente teletransportarse en algún momento del futuro?
cards.back: Will people be able to teleport themselves sometime in the future?

cards.front: ¿Podrá la gente volverse invisible en algún momento del futuro?
cards.back: Will people be able to turn invisible sometime in the future?

cards.front: ¿Podrá la gente caminar sobre el agua en algún momento del futuro?
cards.back: Will people be able to walk on water sometime in the future?

cards.front: ¿Crees que podrás asistir a la reunión de mañana?
cards.back: Do you think you'll be able to make it to tomorrow's meeting?

cards.front: ¿Crees que podrán asistir a la fiesta de inauguración de casa de Linda?
cards.back: Do you think they'll be able to make it to Linda's housewarming party?

cards.front: ¿Crees que Javier podrá asistir a la fiesta de presentación del libro de Bill?
cards.back: Do you think Javier will be able to make it to Bill's book launch party?

cards.front: ¿Crees que podrás aprobar el examen de conducir?
cards.back: Do you reckon you'll be able to pass your driving test?

cards.front: ¿Crees que él podrá ganar el premio?
cards.back: Do you reckon he'll be able to win the award?

cards.front: ¿Crees que podrán montar la sala a tiempo para la conferencia?
cards.back: Do you reckon they'll be able to set up the room in time for the conference?
